Thank you for dining with us

Penong’s Barbecue Seafood & Grill has brought authentic Filipino barbecue to communities across the Philippines since 2003.

Head office: 2nd Floor, McPod Building, McArthur Highway, Matina, Davao City. Phone +63 917 712 9246.
